verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's first-party docs describe AI-Drafted Retrospectives. On incident resolution, AI generates a comprehensive draft built from the incident record, covering overview, timelines, impacts and preliminary Lessons Learned. A per-question "Draft with AI" button in the retrospective template also analyzes the incident's timeline, details and context, so humans can review and edit each field. missing for 10: explicit documentation that drafts cover contributing factors and follow-up action items specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts the postmortem from the incident record — timeline, contributing factors, follow-ups — ready for human review

citations.quote: Upon incident resolution, AI-Drafted Retrospectives generate a comprehensive draft that includes a structured overview of the incident, timelines, impacts, and preliminary Lessons Learned.
When you click "Draft with AI" next to any question in your retrospective template, FireHydrant will: Analyze the incident's timeline, details, and context
FireHydrant's retrospectives feature helps teams facilitate better incident reviews with a flexible template system, collaborative editing, and integrated incident data.
